## New and notable

### App Service

#### [Managed Instance on Azure App Service](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=568952)

App Service - `ga` / `new` - Medium impact

Managed Instance on Azure App Service is now generally available. Managed Instance helps organizations migrate web applications to Azure App Service with minimal configuration and no code changes.

### Azure SQL

#### [Azure SQL Database provisioning in MSSQL extension](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=569160)

Azure SQL - `ga` / `pricing` - Medium impact

With Azure SQL Database provisioning, you can create and connect to a fully managed cloud database directly from your editor—at no cost.

#### [Azure SQL updates for mid-August 2026](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=569145)

Azure SQL - `ga` / `new` - Medium impact

In mid-August 2026, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: You can customize keyboard shortcuts for Quick Queries, the Results Grid, and the Query Editor directly within Visual Studio Code—without leaving your editor.

#### [The Two Hybrid Searches in Microsoft SQL](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/azure-sql/two-hybrid-search/)

Azure SQL - `unknown` / `pricing` - Medium impact

Hybrid search is usually described as combining keyword search with vector search. Microsoft SQL does that, for sure, but we do quite a bit more right out of the box. SQL dynamically evaluates queries and switches between kNN and ANN vector search based on cost and selectivity.

#### [SQL Formatter in MSSQL extension](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=569155)

Azure SQL - `public-preview` / `updated` - Medium impact

With SQL Formatter, you can format SQL scripts directly in your editor for cleaner, more consistent, and readable code.

#### [MSSQL Extension for VS Code: SQL Formatter, Azure SQL Database Provisioning, and More](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/azure-sql/vscode-mssql-august2026/)

Azure SQL - `public-preview` / `updated` - Medium impact

Writing and maintaining SQL is easier when you can eliminate repetitive steps and keep your scripts cleanly formatted. With the MSSQL extension for VS Code v1.45, we’re introducing the Public Preview of the SQL Formatter alongside the General Availability of Azure SQL Database Provisioning and Shortcuts Configuration.
